Hotel Duomo Firenze (Piazza del Duomo 1) sells Duomo View room categories, and Hotel Orafi (Lungarno degli Archibusieri 4) sells a View of the Duomo category. Brunelleschi had no view category on its own page. The own sites of Calzaiuoli, Cavour, Pendini, Helvetia & Bristol, Savoy, Pierre, L'Orologio, Davanzati and Continentale either blocked the tool or named no view category.
